title: Synthesis: reacting thermals established as a new beyond-diffusion class (M lost by its reaction-diffusion twin); heredity and selection in that class is provisional; c52's digestion ecology is the strongest IXDE candidate
summary: Since c47's 00:26 synthesis: c49's reacting thermals are established (beyond diffusion in M, E by construction, audit queued); the Marangoni screen and turnover findings are established with caveats from fresh-seed reviews; the chasing-consumer and prey fuel-fork findings are established. Provisional: the thermals heredity/selection claim (6/6 seeds against an identical-draw twin) and c46's hunting ecology, whose D and E sit in different kinds; submitted: c52's digestion ecology, where both kinds divide and depend dynamically on their own supply. Next: review c52, review the thermals selection claim, and try selection by arrival for the minority-swimmer challenge.
